decisive_spans.text: a rheumatoid factor of 62.29 IU/mL (normal <20 IU/mL), and an anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units

response.rationale: The presence of both rheumatoid factor and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, especially at high levels, is highly specific for seropositive rheumatoid arthritis. While D1 (Mixed Connective Tissue Disease) is supported by high ANA and RF, the strong positive anti-CCP points more directly to D2. D3 (Undifferentiated Connective Tissue Disease) is less specific, and D4 (Psoriatic Arthritis) is contradicted by the lack of psoriasis history.
